note: Trigger evals in the format agentskills.io documents: realistic requests, labelled with whether this skill should be consulted. They test ROUTING, which the assertion evals in evals.json cannot: those are graded by matching the answer text, so they only ever measure what the skill does once it is already loaded. Prompts are written in the vocabulary a maintainer or a reporter uses, deliberately not in the skill's own. Two rules they must keep. No prompt is copied from a benchmark that measures this skill, and no case identifier or measured figure appears here: a skill that ships a benchmark's own prompts contaminates every run it takes part in. Sharing a subject with a benchmark case is unavoidable and fine; sharing its sentences is not.
